items.title: Spider in a Daisy
items.alt: One tiny spider rests at the center of a large white daisy, four legs spread to either side without hiding behind petals.
items.description: One tiny spider rests at the center of a large white daisy, four legs spread to either side without hiding behind petals. Useful for garden stories.

items.title: Spider beside an Acorn Cup
items.alt: A russet spider with eight long walking legs stands behind an empty acorn cup, its short mouth appendages near the rim.
items.description: A russet spider stands behind an empty acorn cup. Useful for woodland crafts and imaginative nature stories.

items.title: Spider Under Curled Bark
items.alt: One spider shelters under a small arch of curled bark, face and all eight legs visible through the open front.
items.description: One spider shelters under a small arch of curled bark, face and all eight legs visible through the open front. Useful for habitat discussion.
